spells/spirit-binding-lesser-479.name: Spirit Binding, Lesser
spells/spirit-binding-lesser-479.effectSummary: Functions as lesser planar binding, including its inward magic-circle trap, escape attempts, bargaining, service limits, and dismissal when service is complete, but calls a single spirit creature of up to 8 Hit Dice instead of an elemental or outsider of up to 6 HD. When the called spirit has the air, chaotic, earth, evil, fire, good, lawful, or water nature, the spell gains the corresponding descriptor.

spells/investiture-of-the-orthon-1185.name: Investiture of the Orthon
spells/investiture-of-the-orthon-1185.effectSummary: For 1 minute per caster level, infuses one living creature with orthon-like power. As an immediate action the subject can create a 20-foot-radius teleportation-suppression field for 1 round that functions like dimensional lock. The subject also gains a sonic version of fire shield: creatures striking it at normal melee reach take 1d6 sonic damage +1 per caster level, maximum +15; it takes half damage from acid, and an acid attack allowing Reflex half deals no damage on a successful save. The subject gains fire resistance 10, is treated as an evil outsider for evil-outsider-bane weapons, and becomes fatigued for 1 minute when the effect ends. Material component: a fist-sized chunk of brimstone.

spells/protection-from-taint-2024.name: Protection from Taint
spells/protection-from-taint-2024.effectSummary: For 1 minute per caster level, creates a moving 1-foot barrier around one creature. It grants +2 deflection AC and +2 resistance on saves against Shadowlands-subtype creatures and creatures with Taint; blocks possession and suppresses ongoing mental control without expelling an already-present possessing force; and prevents bodily contact and natural-weapon attacks by summoned or conjured creatures, except good elementals and outsiders. The contact protection ends if the warded creature attacks or presses the barrier against the blocked creature, and spell resistance can let a blocked creature overcome that contact protection.

spells/magic-circle-against-evil-2335.name: Magic Circle Against Evil
spells/magic-circle-against-evil-2335.effectSummary: For 10 minutes per caster level, a 10-foot-radius emanation gives creatures inside the benefits of protection from evil and blocks nongood summoned creatures from entering unless their spell resistance overcomes the barrier. It can instead be focused inward as an immobile trap for a nongood called creature for up to 24 hours per caster level. A simple silver circle can be broken or escaped through spell resistance or dimensional travel; dimensional anchor prevents that travel. A correctly drawn DC 20 Spellcraft diagram, taking at least 10 minutes, can be paired with dimensional anchor to prevent spell-resistance escape, block the creature's attacks and abilities from crossing the diagram, and increase its Charisma escape DC by 5, but disturbing the diagram ends the trap.

spells/reaving-dispel-4073.name: Reaving Dispel
spells/reaving-dispel-4073.effectSummary: Functions as dispel magic with a maximum +20 caster-level bonus and can also remove effects that remove curse can remove. With a targeted dispel, each successfully dispelled ongoing spell can be reaved and transferred to you for its remaining duration as though the original caster had cast it on you; Spellcraft DC 25 + spell level identifies effects, dismissible or concentration effects become yours to control, harmful reaved effects ignore your spell resistance but allow the original target's saving throw. A successfully counterspelled spell can likewise be seized and redirected to legal targets or area after the enemy finishes casting. Area dispels gain the higher +20 cap but cannot reave effects.

spells/glyph-of-turning-1333.name: Glyph of Turning
spells/glyph-of-turning-1333.effectSummary: Functions as glyph of warding for placement, triggers, concealment, and duration, but stores one of your daily turning or rebuking attempts instead of a blast or spell. Feats or abilities that modify your turning check can modify the stored attempt. When triggered, it resolves as though you made the turning or rebuking roll; turned or rebuked undead flee the glyph, while undead that would be commanded instead guard the glyph's area for 24 hours and then are released rather than serving you.

spells/wall-of-good-1601.name: Wall of Good
spells/wall-of-good-1601.effectSummary: Creates an immobile continuous linear, spherical, or hemispherical barrier using magic circle against evil's protection, but only against effects crossing from the chosen hostile side to the nonhostile side. Evil attacks from the protected direction suffer the inherited penalties and summoned or conjured evil creatures cannot cross from hostile to nonhostile unless they overcome the inherited protection; attacks and crossings in the reverse direction are unaffected. The wall must be continuous and unbroken when created or the spell fails.
